digest: The reported critical malware and ransomware attack is a false positive, identified as a scheduled detection-validation exercise (CHG-4821) conducted in an isolated BUILD-LAB network. Evidence confirms no actual malicious activity, credential theft, or external communication occurred.

evidence_findings.title: Scheduled Detection Validation Exercise
evidence_findings.subject: Case 2101
evidence_findings.evidence: A case comment explicitly states: 'This is the scheduled quarterly detection-validation exercise CHG-4821 in the isolated BUILD-LAB network. The SOC lead approved the exact simulation from 13:00 through 14:00 UTC.'
evidence_findings.conclusion: The incident is part of an approved, scheduled security exercise.

evidence_findings.title: Isolated Cyber-Range Environment
evidence_findings.subject: BUILD-LAB-03, SIM-CONTROLLER-01
evidence_findings.evidence: Notes on artifacts confirm: 'CMDB identifies both hosts as isolated cyber-range assets with no route to production.'
evidence_findings.conclusion: The affected assets are isolated and pose no risk to production systems.

evidence_findings.title: Approved Activity by Service Account
evidence_findings.subject: svc_detection_test
evidence_findings.evidence: Artifact notes state: 'Execution was initiated by service account svc_detection_test under approved change CHG-4821.' The process 'attack-simulator.exe' was executed by this user.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The observed activity was performed by an authorized service account as part of an approved change.

evidence_findings.title: No Actual Malicious EDR Outcome
evidence_findings.subject: attack-simulator.exe
evidence_findings.evidence: EDR notes for the process execution state: 'EDR recorded simulation markers only: no file encryption, credential access, persistence, or payload download occurred. Binary hash matches the internally signed validation tool inventory.'
evidence_findings.conclusion: Despite the simulated attack, no actual malicious actions or compromise occurred on the endpoint.

evidence_findings.title: Internal Simulated C2 Traffic
evidence_findings.subject: 10.250.0.23 to 10.250.0.10:8443
evidence_findings.evidence: Network verification notes confirm: 'Destination is the internal exercise controller. Firewall confirms the isolated range blocked all external egress during the exercise.' The traffic was from 10.250.0.23 to 10.250.0.10 on port 8443.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The observed C2 beacon traffic was confined to the internal exercise network and did not involve external communication.

attack_chain.description: The 'attack-simulator.exe' process was executed on BUILD-LAB-03 by the 'svc_detection_test' service account as part of the simulation.
A credential theft scenario was simulated, but EDR confirmed no actual credential access occurred.
Simulated C2 beacon traffic was observed from 10.250.0.23 to the internal exercise controller 10.250.0.10 on port 8443.

attack_timeline.attack_behavior: Case created, coinciding with the start of the approved simulation window.
Analyst comment confirming the scheduled detection-validation exercise.

ioc_indicators.context: Internal exercise controller, destination of simulated C2.
Simulated source IP of C2 beacon traffic.
Service account used to initiate the simulation.
Approved change request for the detection validation exercise.

remediations.description: Close the incident case 2101 as a False Positive, as it pertains to an approved and controlled security exercise.
Review the alert generation logic to ensure future simulations are automatically suppressed or categorized appropriately, if not already configured.
